title: Assembly of the normalized comparison at one base
statement: For every prime ℓ and scheme X there is an AdicModuleSectionComparison as in lem-sf-adic-module-section-data whose coefficient ring sheaf is exactly the explicitly constructed comparisonRing of lem-sf-adic-section-module-equivalence. Its equivalence, unchanged additive sections, regular-module comparison and coordinate-preserving free-module comparisons are constructed, and its tensor/Hom fields are supplied by lem-sf-adic-module-tensor-hom-comparison.

proof.text: Take the explicit coefficient sheaf, equivalence and identity maps on sections from the section-module equivalence construction. Its action and restriction formulas are definitional. Use its unit and free-coordinate comparisons. Fill the tensor, Hom and bidual fields with the fixed-functor closed comparison. The coefficient sheaf equality is reflexivity.

proof_origin.place: Native/sectionwise module comparison, Stacks 03CV, 03EK, 03EO and 0E8H; formal assembly follows the section normalizations.
